summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.93. Confirmed account takeover for z.korkmaz@aegean.edu. This is not explainable by travel or normal behavior; the account is compromised and requires immediate containment (disable session, force password reset, review MFA methods, remove mailbox rule).
